(approve some rows to see the plan)

Then run: python3 catalog/repricing/2026-05-18-1off-bronx-otd/apply_plan.py plan.json (dry-run by default; pass --apply to write).

Computation reference.
  • Chain (global) price is read live from state dealer 210248.
  • Proposed values are local-only scratch; nothing is written.
  • OTD = pre-tax price × 1.13 (NY combined sales tax).
  • Effective promo % for a row = row override > group override > brand override > page default.
  • GM% = 1 − (1.13 × cost) / price — matches reprice.py's convention.
  • Approve rolls UP: a brand's pill shows approved only when every product under it is approved; mixed when some rows disagree.
  • Apply engine differentiates global vs local edits per row using the radio. Local-override creation, update, and reset are all distinct calls.
